description: This file declares the CdmBackend class, which implements the ICdmBackend interface and the IControlClient interface. It manages DRM-related operations such as session management, key handling, and DRM store interactions within a media application.

classes.name: CdmBackend
classes.description: A class that provides DRM backend functionalities, including session management, key handling, and DRM store operations, implementing ICdmBackend and IControlClient interfaces.
